evidence_scope: Credential-free DNS/TCP/TLS probe only; no HTTP or model request. Historical run had only sanitized error, so its exact failing stage cannot be reconstructed.
defect: Previous transport tried alternate approved IPs only on TCP failure, never on a stalled TLS handshake.
fix: Bound DNS plus TCP/TLS connection establishment to 10s overall, each address at most 3s and a fair remaining-budget share; validate the entire answer, use numeric addresses, preserve hostname verification and negotiated ALPN; no HTTP replay.
